RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning your sex was not a factor in choosing him over you. While an all-male panel points to poor institutional gender diversity within the broadcaster, it does not support an allegation of sex discrimination in this specific decision. 

Raising the panel’s gender makeup would undermine your credibility and distract from legitimate queries. A more productive approach is to follow up politely on your requested written feedback. Focus on how the panel evaluated qualifications—specifically your five years of leadership as deputy editor versus his digital media background—to gain actionable insights or identify whether other factors, such as age, may have influenced the choice.
